planDefinitions.description: Paths to the generated PlanDefinition resources.

bpmnFiles.description: Paths to the source BPMN files. Required: without them the round trip can only be checked in one direction, which is the direction that misses silently dropped nodes.

traceability.description: Links emitted by the authoring skill. Where absent, correspondence is recovered from action.sourceNodeId and any mismatch is reported rather than repaired.

runPublisher.description: Run the IG Publisher for profile conformance. Setting this false makes tier 2 report not-run; it does not make it pass.
